# FlexRibbon: Joint Sequence and Structure Pretraining for Protein Modeling [![Conference Paper](http://img.shields.io/badge/ICLR-2026-blue.svg)](https://openreview.net/forum?id=B8BXHrshMi) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0)
## Introduction This repository contains the implementation for the ICLR2026 paper, "FlexRibbon: Joint Sequence and Structure Pretraining for Protein Modeling". [link](https://openreview.net/forum?id=B8BXHrshMi) ## Installation ```bash git clone https://github.com/bjzgcai/FlexRibbon.git cd FlexRibbon conda env create -f environment.yaml conda activate FlexRibbon ``` ## Model Weights Pretrained model weights could be found [https://huggingface.co/penguin-catalina/FlexRibbon](https://huggingface.co/penguin-catalina/FlexRibbon). ## Usage ### 1. Data Preparation FlexRibbon loads data efficiently using LMDB. To create an LMDB dataset from your raw JSON files: ```bash python tools/make-sample-lmdb.py \ --json example/1ab9.json \ --target example/1ab9.lmdb ``` Detailed json format describled in [tools/make-sample-lmdb.py](tools/make-sample-lmdb.py). ### 2. Inference To run inference using the generated LMDB and pre-trained weights: ```bash torchrun --nproc_per_node gpu --master_port 12345 src/tasks/sample.py \ --config-name=$FlexRibbonConfig \ sample_in_validation=true \ max_length=4800 \ data_path= \ num_sampling_time= \ loadcheck_path= \ sampled_structure_output_path= \ crop_radius=10000 \ ligand_crop_size=10000 \ edm_sample_num_steps=250 \ seed=42 \ finetune_module=confidence_head \ extra_modules=true ``` ## License This project is licensed under the [Apache 2.0 License](LICENSE). ## Citing FlexRibbon If you find our work helpful, please consider citing our paper: ``` @inproceedings{ zhu2026flexribbon, title={{FlexRibbon:} Joint Sequence and Structure Pretraining for Protein Modeling}, author={Jianwei Zhu and Yu Shi and Ran Bi and Peiran Jin and Chang Liu and Zhe Zhang and Haitao Huang and Zekun Guo and Pipi Hu and Fusong Ju and Lin Huang and Xinwei Tai and Chenao Li and Kaiyuan Gao and Xinran Wei and Huanhuan Xia and Jia Zhang and Yaosen Min and Zun Wang and Yusong Wang and Liang He and Haiguang Liu and Tao Qin}, booktitle={The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations}, year={2026}, url={https://openreview.net/forum?id=B8BXHrshMi} } ```
